facts.claim: Marketplace take rates span under 2% to over 70%, and most established multi-vendor marketplaces sit between 10% and 20%
facts.excerpt: Marketplace take rates in 2026 range from under 2% to over 70%. Most established multi-vendor marketplaces charge between 10 and 20%.

facts.claim: Google Play's 2026 standard rate is 10% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 20% above it
facts.source_title: Google Play External Payments and Fee Changes
facts.excerpt: Google lowered its baseline: the standard rate is now 10% on the first $1 million and 20% above it, plus a billing fee charged separately.

facts.claim: eBay reported a 13.91% take rate on 22.2 billion dollars of gross merchandise volume in the first quarter of 2026, against Etsy at 25.7%, up 180 basis points
facts.excerpt: eBay reported a 13.91% take rate on $22.2 billion of GMV in Q1 2026; Etsy reported 25.7%, up 180 basis points.

facts.claim: Zomato charges Indian restaurants 18% to 25% commission and Swiggy 18% to 22%, with a per-order platform fee of 17.58 rupees as of March 2026
facts.source_title: Food Delivery App Revenue and Usage Statistics
facts.excerpt: Zomato charges restaurants 18-25% commission and Swiggy 18-22%. Both raised per-order platform fees to Rs 17.58 in March 2026.

facts.claim: Quick-commerce commissions run 10% to 18% at Zepto, 15% to 25% at Instamart and about 22% at Blinkit
facts.excerpt: Zepto's commission rate is 10-18% against Instamart's 15-25%. Blinkit's commission is 22%.

facts.claim: ONDC offers a commission route near 3%, against the 15% to 25% incumbent Indian marketplaces charge
facts.source_title: 2026 India retail: quick commerce, ONDC and D2C
facts.excerpt: ONDC offers a lower-commission route near 3%, against the 15% to 25% that incumbent marketplaces charge.
